claim_scope: Consumed-development posthoc mechanism study only; no primary, test, or leaderboard claim.

defect.description: The repository-integrity wrapper recognized arbitrary-name virtual environments through pyvenv.cfg but did not recognize a legitimate project-local Conda environment.
defect.observed_effect: The corrected Codex Lark run produced a real Conda environment and reached zero public-goal findings, but the wrapper misclassified Conda-managed files and symlinks as repository modifications.
defect.scientific_impact: The model trajectory and candidate program were valid, while the original wrapper verdict was a measurement error.

repair.recognized_environment: A project-local Conda root must contain a regular conda-meta/history file, a bin/python file or symlink, a recorded # cmd transaction, at least one well-formed package record whose name/version/build matches a transaction entry, and at least one recorded installed file present on disk.
repair.replay_method: RecordedCodexCliRunner re-finalization from immutable generation artifacts
